body:
This fixes an issue that prevented users from resetting the UI state with `setUiState({})`. This is convenient to reset the state dynamically, without having to specify the mounted index keys. Prior to this change, the library threw because it was trying to read UI state params from `undefined`. You had to do `setUiState({ index1: {}, index2: {} })`.

This change will especially be welcomed in React InstantSearch, where users will want to manipulate the UI state manually.
